recommendation.run_limitations: Result provenance: deterministic. This result identifies the best-performing action among the candidates tested under the declared evaluator metrics, computed only from recorded simulation traces; it is not a guarantee of real-world outcome. Ranking uses the declared metrics only: the primary metric (recipient_reply_sent) first, then each secondary metric compared descending in declared order (highest value first; polarity not inferred); any remaining exact tie is broken by candidate_id in ascending lexicographic order (code-owned final tie-break; not needed in this ranking). Every branch's intervention was measured to reach an actor other than the insertion actor.
